title: Perfordium
description: Makes minecarft smooth even on low end hardware!
body:
This is a modpack made for people with low-end hardware like my VERY low-end hardware.
Usually i get 20-30fps at medium settings but with this set of mods can get arounf 60-90FPS in medium settings
## Features:
- Increases FPS on Low-end Hardware, 
- Includes QoL Features,
- Has minimaps,
- Zoom,
- Greatly improves FPS in PvP Servers.
### READ BEFORE INSTALLING
**I Recommend you to use JAVA 22 To Avoid specific crashes.**
